# Colorado Bounce Club — Pueblo, Colorado Springs & Southern Colorado
> Southern Colorado's Premier Party Rental & Mobile Entertainment Service. Commercial-grade bounce houses, giant water slides, obstacle courses, and 10-player mobile tactical laser tag delivered, sanitized, and set up in your yard or event park.

## Business Overview
- **Business Name:** Colorado Bounce Club
- **Primary Service Area:** Pueblo, Pueblo West, Colorado Springs, Fountain, Canon City, and surrounding Southern Colorado communities
- **Direct Phone / SMS Booking:** (719) 251-1182
- **Website:** https://coloradobounceclub.com/
- **Key Guarantee:** Free delivery & setup in Pueblo & El Paso counties, fully insured, deep-sanitized before every event.

## Featured Rental Packages & Pricing (USD)
- **10-Player Mobile Tactical Laser Tag:** $200 (All-Day Rental)
  - Includes 10 high-precision laser phasers, inflatable pop-up tactical bunkers, team vests, and game referee.
- **Commercial Dual-Lane Water Slide / Mega Slip:** $250 (All-Day Rental)
  - Heavy-duty commercial vinyl with high splash pools. Insured, deep-cleaned, and anchored.
- **Castle & Obstacle Course Combos:** $180 (All-Day Rental)
  - Climbing wall, bounce arena, and dual exit slides. Hours of nonstop energy for birthdays.
- **School Field Day & Church Youth Specials:** Custom Multi-Unit Discounts
  - Discounted multi-unit package deals for PTAs, youth pastors, parks & rec, and corporate picnics.
